rules.name: Vague attribution
rules.description: Unspecified experts or studies cannot be checked by the reader.
rules.message: The claim is attributed to an unnamed source.
rules.suggestion: Name and cite the source, or remove the attribution and narrow the claim.

rules.name: Generic positive ending
rules.description: A universally positive ending can be removed without changing the document's information.
rules.message: The ending closes with generic optimism rather than a fact or next step.
rules.suggestion: End with a concrete commitment, constraint, result, or stop where the thought ends.

patterns: (?:the future (?:looks|is) bright|this is only the beginning|the possibilities are endless|exciting times lie ahead)\.?\s*$

rules.name: Claim of a deeper truth
rules.description: Abstract 'deeper truth' framing often restates the preceding point at a higher level.
rules.message: The sentence elevates a claim instead of making it more specific.
rules.suggestion: Keep the evidence or decision and remove the abstract moral if it adds nothing.

patterns: \b(?:at its core|the deeper truth is|what really matters is|the real lesson is)\b

rules.name: Unprompted objection
rules.description: Answering an objection nobody raised can reveal discarded drafting scaffolding.
rules.message: The text introduces a hypothetical objection without showing that readers actually have it.
rules.suggestion: Keep it only when the objection is real and relevant; otherwise state the supported choice.

patterns: \b(?:you might be wondering|some may argue|a common objection is|it may be tempting to think)\b
